items.title: Jeremy Sochan will be the No. 1 pick of the G League Draft, sources told HoopsHype. Sochan will join the Dallas Mavericks’ affiliate, Texas Legends, and attempt to work his way back to the NBA. He’s averaged 9.9 points and 5.4 rebounds in four seasons with the Spurs and Knicks.
